BL-1097 — The coordinator's router hands a role a parcel whose commit already contains that ticket's finished, QA-approved work - nothing advances `status:` past `todo`, so an active ticket looks unstarted until bookkeeping closes it
What it solves: Reported by the coder, twice. The first note - "4 misroutes: active tickets keep mint status:todo assigned_to:coder forever" - was accurate, and the specifier's first investigation did not confirm it: it checked the daemon's auto-route path rather than the coordinator's, and read the wrong mailbox …
Approval context: Firm: a role must not be handed a parcel whose commit already contains that ticket's finished work. Article 1.9 forbids FORWARDING a no-op parcel; this is the same rule applied to the router that originates one.
Your call is which signal the router should read, and I have a recommendation. The daem…
BL-1097 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1097" (or "reject BL-1097 <reason>") to act.
